text:
katie billing: Invoice from StratusGrid (INV-2026-0421) for $18,450 arrived — due EOM. PDF link in thread. No PO on invoice, vendor put 'N/A' in PO field. Can we get approver routing? :warning:

approvals-bot: Auto-detect — invoice INV-2026-0421 (USD 18,450) not matched to an active PO. Routing to #finance for manual review. Queue: finance-procurement-queue. ETA: ~2h for ack.

jordan procurement: @katie billing thanks. Do we have vendor ID or an existing contract reference? If there's no PO we need either vendor onboarding + one-time PO or a retro PO (retro PO requires finance + ops approval).

katie billing: Vendor: StratusGrid Inc — vendor code STRATUS-13 in our vendor DB (old). Attached invoice excerpt:
```
Vendor: StratusGrid Inc
Invoice: INV-2026-0421
PO: N/A
Total: 18,450.00
Due: 2026-05-31
```

ana finance: Put GL=5002 (Cloud infra). Chargeback to cost center: infra-prod. We can clear payment this cycle if procurement creates a retro PO and legal signs off. :+1:

mike ops: Confirm infra-prod. This line is the burst capacity add-on for April usage — expected. Ops sign-off. :white_check_mark:

lucy legal: I need to confirm the contract allows retroactive PO or if invoice references an SOW. For amounts > $10k we require contract attestation. Can someone drop the contract ID or clause?

jordan procurement: I'll create a retro PO in Coupa — PO-2026-STR-0897 — and route for approvals. Requesting approvals from @emma infra-lead and @ana finance. Tagging: @emma @ana finance.

emma infra-lead: I reviewed usage notes — happy to approve the PO for this billing period, assuming standard terms. :eyes:

ana finance: Approved conditionally on legal attestation. @lucy can you confirm the clause so payments can proceed?

lucy legal: I pulled contract CG-2023-17. Clause 5.2 covers recurring services and allows retro PO in cases of vendor invoicing timing; legal attests. I'll paste the excerpt in the doc. :white_check_mark:

approvals-bot: PO PO-2026-STR-0897 created and linked to invoice INV-2026-0421. Status: Approved by ops, finance pending legal attestation (received). Payment scheduled for 2026-05-28.

katie billing: Thanks — marking invoice as approved and moving to payments queue. Will attach PO and legal snippet to the payment record. :tada:
